description: Admin UI page for triaging pending mcp_submissions (admin view of the portal). Serves on port 8790. Fetches rows via write_service query endpoint, renders table with columns: mcp_name, requested_by, requested_at, status, notes. Shows triage buttons: Approve, Conditional, Reject. Embedded CSS. Read mcp_submissions table schema from DB_SCHEMA.md for correct column names (mcp_name not mcp_identifier, requested_by not requester_name).
